title: Number of Provinces
description:
You are given n cities and a matrix isConnected of size n × n.

isConnected[i][j] = 1 → city i and city j are directly connected
isConnected[i][j] = 0 → no direct connection
Definition

A province is a group of cities that are:

Directly connected, or
Indirectly connected (through other cities)
Task

Return the number of provinces (connected groups of cities).

Examples

Example 1

[[1,1,0],
 [1,1,0],
 [0,0,1]]
→ 2

Example 2

[[1,0,0],
 [0,1,0],
 [0,0,1]]
→ 3
Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200
Matrix is:
Symmetric (i ↔ j)
Diagonal always 1
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
